build_Minecraft_structure: build a Minecraft structure by calling Interpreter.handle_build to place blocks from a schematic at a target location
destroy_Minecraft_object: destroy a Minecraft object by calling Interpreter.handle_destroy to remove blocks matching a reference object filter
modify_Minecraft_structure: modify a Minecraft structure by calling Interpreter.handle_modify to scale, replace, fill, or apply rigid motion to an object
dig_Minecraft_hole: dig a Minecraft hole by calling Interpreter.handle_dig with depth, length, and width attributes at a specified location
spawn_Minecraft_mob: spawn a Minecraft mob by calling Interpreter.handle_spawn with a mob name and target location
